title: [FEAT] Lane connections on complex roads
summary: I've created this complex boulevard using the addon, but one frustrating part is having to configure the lane connections separately using another addon. By default, all lanes are connected to each other, so I have to manually adjust the connections every ~300m, wherever the road automatically creates a new segment. This gets quite tedious, especially on longer roads. It would be great if we could **configure lane connections directly within the road template**, so they're automatically applied when placing the road, rather than having to set them up manually afterward. This is a large, complex boulevard with parking spaces and a separate lane running in the opposite direction, designed to provide access to parking areas and building entrances and exits.
